parts.name: TMOS PIR complete native assembled front and rear shell

notes: All3490 native assembled front/rear triangles retained at scale1 under one common translation only. Components1/2 are displaced duplicate rear/front shells. Front optical window, mounting bores, Grove cutout, rear label recess and M5 relief remain unchanged. PCB, STHS34PF80 LGA package and optical filter/internal backing, XC6228 regulator and passive population, Grove interior and fastener installation are visual reconstruction. Official table thickness5.2mm conflicts with own dimensional drawing and STL8mm; original shell remains scale1.
